Generic OPTION CLAUSE: The Purchaser reserves the right to increase or decrease the quantity to be ordered up to 50 percent of bid quantity at the time of placement of contract. The purchaser also reserves the right to increase the ordered quantity up to 50% of the contracted quantity during the currency of the contract at the contracted rates. The delivery period of quantity shall commence from the last date of original delivery order and in cases where option clause is exercised during the extended delivery period the additional time shall commence from the last date of extended delivery period. The additional delivery time shall be (Increased quantity ÷ Original quantity) × Original delivery period (in days), subject to minimum of 30 days. If the original delivery period is less than 30 days, the additional time equals the original delivery period. The Purchaser may extend this calculated delivery duration up to the original delivery period while exercising the option clause. Bidders must comply with these terms. 5. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses 1. ATC Specifications will supersede the golden parameters selected in the bid. 2. If requested, samples shall be provided by the bidder free of cost. Sample evaluation may form part of the technical evaluation process. If a bidder’s sampl e is rejected, the bidder shall be disqualified from the technical evaluation, and n o further correspondence regarding such rejection shall be entertained. 3. Pre-Contract Integrity Pact: The bidder shall submit the Pre-Contract Integrity Pact duly filled in and signed, as per the format enclosed in ATC on a ₹100/- non- judicial stamp paper. Failure to submit the duly executed Integrity Pact along wi th the technical bid shall render the bidder liable for disqualification/rejection of the bid. 4. Non-Blacklisting affidavit: The bidder shall submit a duly signed and stamped affidavit of non-blacklisting on a ₹100/- non-judicial stamp paper, confirming tha t the firm/company has not been blacklisted, debarred, or suspended by any Cen tral/State Government Department, Government Institution, PSU, Autonomous B ody, or any other Government organization. Failure to submit the required declar ation may result in rejection/disqualification of the bid. .
